package.name: gz_hydrodynamics
package.description:
Gazebo's Hydrodynamics system, damping a vehicle against the water rather than the ground: it reads the world's ocean current from gz_ocean_current at the link's centre of mass, so every vehicle, loaded with the world or spawned at run time, feels it with its Fossen coefficients unchanged. It also reads a current table loaded by EnvironmentPreload on a vehicle spawned after the first step, which upstream does not.
Vendored from gz-sim, a fork until upstream reads a current from the ECM; see PROVENANCE.md.
